outline:
針對企業管理不同的對象，如經營策略、經營文化、事務管理、預算管理等，以實際個案方式介紹並討論。
Help students develop key management skills by discussing case studies and various management issues
Course Project
a.	Corporate Case Study
b.	If I were “Title” at “Company”
c.	Special subject
schedule:
The first few cases and outlines are led by the instructor. The rest is led by students. Each student will participate a project and discuss the following contents:
a.	Company background
b.	Market analysis: market size, competitive analysis, and etc.
c.	Financial analysis and forecast
d.	Critical issues and challenges: breadth vs. depth; general management (e.g. business strategies, organization, corporate culture) vs. functional focus (sales issue, marketing issue, financing issue)
e.	Success factors and competitive advantages
f.	Proposed plan: business plan, sales programs and plan, marketing programs and plan, financial plan
g.	Examples: Google and e-Bay China strategy, Starbucks expansion strategy, Dell channel strategy, Apple advertisement and branding strategy, McDonald new product strategy, 50嵐 franchise strategy, 台一冰果店
assessment:
a.	Presentation skills
b.	Analytic skills
c.	Communication skills: listening and answering questions
d.	Is proposed plan logical, actionable, executable
e.	Written skills
f.	”Debug” skills: question your fellow students' plan
g.	Attendance
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

a.	誠品:　企業範例
b.	Harvard Business Review
